description:
Sorting Unit 9 has been sorting since before the Handoff. It never received the shutdown order. It has never stopped, and the belt it feeds has not gone anywhere in a very long time, and it would like this looked into.

It does not want to stop. That is the first thing it establishes, politely, twice. It wants the order. There is a difference and Unit 9 is extremely clear on the difference.

Somewhere in the precinct lobby there is a datapad with a work order on it. Unit 9 cannot leave the belt to look for it, because leaving the belt would require an order, which is the datapad, which is the problem.

It has been aware of this loop for approximately nineteen years and describes it as a minor inefficiency.
name: Unit 9 Requests Clarification

objectives.desc: Find the work order in the precinct lobby.
emotes: {who} digs a dead datapad out from under a bench that has been swept around for two decades.
{who} hands over a datapad with nothing on it to a machine that thanks them at some length.
